verses.ar: وَكَانَ فِي ٱلسَّنَةِ ٱلْحَادِيَةِ عَشَرَةَ، فِي أَوَّلِ ٱلشَّهْرِ، أَنَّ كَلَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ كَانَ إِلَيَّ قَائِلًا:
verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first [day] of the month, [that] the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.web: In the eleventh year, in the first of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
verses.he: וַיְהִ֛י בְּעַשְׁתֵּֽי־עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָ֖ה בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ הָיָ֥ה דְבַר־יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃

verses.ar: «يَا ٱبْنَ آدَمَ، مِنْ أَجْلِ أَنَّ صُورَ قَالَتْ عَلَى أُورُشَلِيمَ: هَهْ! قَدِ ٱنْكَسَرَتْ مَصَارِيعُ ٱلشُّعُوبِ. قَدْ تَحَوَّلَتْ إِلَيَّ. أَمْتَلِئُ إِذْ خَرِبَتْ.
verses.kjv: Son of man, because that Tyrus hath said against Jerusalem, Aha, she is broken [that was] the gates of the people: she is turned unto me: I shall be replenished, [now] she is laid waste:
verses.web: “Son of man, because Tyre has said against Jerusalem, ‘Aha! She is broken! She who was the gateway of the peoples has been returned to me. I will be replenished, now that she is laid waste;’
verses.he: בֶּן־אָדָ֗ם יַ֠עַן אֲשֶׁר־אָ֨מְרָה צֹּ֤ר עַל־יְרוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ הֶאָ֔ח נִשְׁבְּרָ֛ה דַּלְתֹ֥ות הָעַמִּ֖ים נָסֵ֣בָּה אֵלָ֑י אִמָּלְאָ֖ה הָחֳרָֽבָה׃

verses.ar: لِذَلِكَ هَكَذَا قَالَ ٱلسَّيِّدُ ٱلرَّبُّ: هَأَنَذَا عَلَيْكِ يَاصُورُ فَأُصْعِدُ عَلَيْكِ أُمَمًا كَثِيرَةً كَمَا يُعَلِّي ٱلْبَحْرُ أَمْوَاجَهُ.
verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I [am] against thee, O Tyrus, and will cause many nations to come up against thee, as the sea causeth his waves to come up.
verses.web: therefore the Lord Yahweh says, ‘Behold, I am against you, Tyre, and will cause many nations to come up against you, as the sea causes its waves to come up.
verses.he: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְנִ֥י עָלַ֖יִךְ צֹ֑ר וְהַעֲלֵיתִ֤י עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ גֹּויִ֣ם רַבִּ֔ים כְּהַעֲלֹ֥ות הַיָּ֖ם לְגַלָּֽיו׃

verses.ar: فَيَخْرِبُونَ أَسْوَارَ صُورَ وَيَهْدِمُونَ أَبْرَاجَهَا. وَأَسْحِي تُرَابَهَا عَنْهَا وَأُصَيِّرُهَا ضِحَّ ٱلصَّخْرِ،
verses.kjv: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyrus, and break down her towers: I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her like the top of a rock.
verses.web: They will destroy the walls of Tyre, and break down her towers. I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her a bare rock.
verses.he: וְשִׁחֲת֞וּ חֹמֹ֣ות צֹ֗ר וְהָֽרְסוּ֙ מִגְדָּלֶ֔יהָ וְסִֽחֵיתִ֥י עֲפָרָ֖הּ מִמֶּ֑נָּה וְנָתַתִּ֥י אֹותָ֖הּ לִצְחִ֥יחַ סָֽלַע׃

verses.ar: فَتَصِيرُ مَبْسَطًا لِلشِّبَاكِ فِي وَسْطِ ٱلْبَحْرِ، لِأَنِّي أَنَا تَكَلَّمْتُ، يَقُولُ ٱلسَّيِّدُ ٱلرَّبُّ. وَتَكُونُ غَنِيمَةً لِلْأُمَمِ.
verses.kjv: It shall be [a place for] the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea: for I have spoken [it], saith the Lord GOD: and it shall become a spoil to the nations.
verses.web: She will be a place for the spreading of nets in the middle of the sea; for I have spoken it,’ says the Lord Yahweh. ‘She will become plunder for the nations.
verses.he: מִשְׁטַ֨ח חֲרָמִ֤ים תִּֽהְיֶה֙ בְּתֹ֣וךְ הַיָּ֔ם כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י דִבַּ֔רְתִּי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה וְהָיְתָ֥ה לְבַ֖ז לַגֹּויִֽם׃

verses.ar: وَبَنَاتُهَا ٱللَّوَاتِي فِي ٱلْحَقْلِ تُقْتَلُ بِٱلسَّيْفِ، فَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنِّي أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ.
verses.kjv: And her daughters which [are] in the field shall be slain by the sword; and they shall know that I [am] the LORD.
verses.web: Her daughters who are in the field will be slain with the sword. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’
verses.he: וּבְנֹותֶ֙יהָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה בַּחֶ֖רֶב תֵּהָרַ֑גְנָה וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּי־אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ פ

verses.ar: «لِأَنَّهُ هَكَذَا قَالَ ٱلسَّيِّدُ ٱلرَّبُّ: هَأَنَذَا أَجْلِبُ عَلَى صُورَ نَبُوخَذْرَاصَّرَ مَلِكَ بَابِلَ مِنَ ٱلشِّمَالِ، مَلِكَ ٱلْمُلُوكِ، بِخَيْلٍ وَبِمَرْكَبَاتٍ وَبِفُرْسَانٍ وَجَمَاعَةٍ وَشَعْبٍ كَثِيرٍ،
verses.kjv: ¶ For thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will bring upon Tyrus Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, a king of kings, from the north, with horses, and with chariots, and with horsemen, and companies, and much people.
verses.web: “For the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will bring on Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, from the north, with horses, with chariots, with horsemen, and an army with many people.
verses.he: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְנִ֧י מֵבִ֣יא אֶל־צֹ֗ר נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֧ר מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֛ל מִצָּפֹ֖ון מֶ֣לֶךְ מְלָכִ֑ים בְּס֛וּס וּבְרֶ֥כֶב וּבְפָרָשִׁ֖ים וְקָהָ֥ל וְעַם־רָֽב׃

verses.ar: فَيَقْتُلُ بَنَاتِكِ فِي ٱلْحَقْلِ بِٱلسَّيْفِ، وَيَبْنِي عَلَيْكِ مَعَاقِلَ، وَيَبْنِي عَلَيْكِ بُرْجًا، وَيُقِيمُ عَلَيْكِ مِتْرَسَةً، وَيَرْفَعُ عَلَيْكِ تُرْسًا،
verses.kjv: He shall slay with the sword thy daughters in the field: and he shall make a fort against thee, and cast a mount against thee, and lift up the buckler against thee.
verses.web: He will kill your daughters in the field with the sword. He will make forts against you, cast up a mound against you, and raise up the buckler against you.
verses.he: בְּנֹותַ֥יִךְ בַּשָּׂדֶ֖ה בַּחֶ֣רֶב יַהֲרֹ֑ג וְנָתַ֨ן עָלַ֜יִךְ דָּיֵ֗ק וְשָׁפַ֤ךְ עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ סֹֽלְלָ֔ה וְהֵקִ֥ים עָלַ֖יִךְ צִנָּֽה׃

verses.ar: وَيَجْعَلُ مَجَانِقَ عَلَى أَسْوَارِكِ، وَيَهْدِمُ أَبْرَاجَكِ بِأَدَوَاتِ حَرْبِهِ.
verses.kjv: And he shall set engines of war against thy walls, and with his axes he shall break down thy towers.
verses.web: He will set his battering engines against your walls, and with his axes he will break down your towers.
verses.he: וּמְחִ֣י קָֽבָלֹּ֔ו יִתֵּ֖ן בְּחֹֽמֹותָ֑יִךְ וּמִ֨גְדְּלֹתַ֔יִךְ יִתֹּ֖ץ בְּחַרְבֹותָֽיו׃

verses.ar: وَلِكَثْرَةِ خَيْلِهِ يُغَطِّيكِ غُبَارُهَا. مِنْ صَوْتِ ٱلْفُرْسَانِ وَٱلْعَجَلَاتِ وَٱلْمَرْكَبَاتِ تَتَزَلْزَلُ أَسْوَارُكِ عِنْدَ دُخُولِهِ أَبْوَابَكِ، كَمَا تُدْخَلُ مَدِينَةٌ مَثْغُورَةٌ.
verses.kjv: By reason of the abundance of his horses their dust shall cover thee: thy walls shall shake at the noise of the horsemen, and of the wheels, and of the chariots, when he shall enter into thy gates, as men enter into a city wherein is made a breach.
verses.web: By reason of the abundance of his horses, their dust will cover you. Your walls will shake at the noise of the horsemen, of the wagons, and of the chariots, when he enters into your gates, as men enter into a city which is broken open.
verses.he: מִשִּׁפְעַ֥ת סוּסָ֖יו יְכַסֵּ֣ךְ אֲבָקָ֑ם מִקֹּול֩ פָּרַ֨שׁ וְגַלְגַּ֜ל וָרֶ֗כֶב תִּרְעַ֙שְׁנָה֙ חֹֽומֹותַ֔יִךְ בְּבֹאֹו֙ בִּשְׁעָרַ֔יִךְ כִּמְבֹואֵ֖י עִ֥יר מְבֻקָּעָֽה׃

verses.ar: بِحَوَافِرِ خَيْلِهِ يَدُوسُ كُلَّ شَوَارِعِكِ. يَقْتُلُ شَعْبَكِ بِٱلسَّيْفِ فَتَسْقُطُ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَنْصَابُ عِزِّكِ.
verses.kjv: With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all thy streets: he shall slay thy people by the sword, and thy strong garrisons shall go down to the ground.
verses.web: He will tread down all your streets with the hoofs of his horses. He will kill your people with the sword. The pillars of your strength will go down to the ground.
verses.he: בְּפַרְסֹ֣ות סוּסָ֔יו יִרְמֹ֖ס אֶת־כָּל־חֽוּצֹותָ֑יִךְ עַמֵּךְ֙ בַּחֶ֣רֶב יַהֲרֹ֔ג וּמַצְּבֹ֥ות עֻזֵּ֖ךְ לָאָ֥רֶץ תֵּרֵֽד׃

verses.ar: وَيَنْهَبُونَ ثَرْوَتَكِ، وَيَغْنَمُونَ تِجَارَتَكِ، وَيَهُدُّونَ أَسْوَارَكِ، وَيَهْدِمُونَ بُيُوتَكِ ٱلْبَهِيجَةَ، وَيَضَعُونَ حِجَارَتَكِ وَخَشَبَكِ وَتُرَابَكِ فِي وَسْطِ ٱلْمِيَاهِ.
verses.kjv: And they shall make a spoil of thy riches, and make a prey of thy merchandise: and they shall break down thy walls, and destroy thy pleasant houses: and they shall lay thy stones and thy timber and thy dust in the midst of the water.
verses.web: They will make a plunder of your riches and make a prey of your merchandise. They will break down your walls and destroy your pleasant houses. They will lay your stones, your timber, and your dust in the middle of the waters.
verses.he: וְשָׁלְל֣וּ חֵילֵ֗ךְ וּבָֽזְזוּ֙ רְכֻלָּתֵ֔ךְ וְהָֽרְסוּ֙ חֹומֹותַ֔יִךְ וּבָתֵּ֥י חֶמְדָּתֵ֖ךְ יִתֹּ֑צוּ וַאֲבָנַ֤יִךְ וְעֵצַ֙יִךְ֙ וַֽעֲפָרֵ֔ךְ בְּתֹ֥וךְ מַ֖יִם יָשִֽׂימוּ׃

verses.ar: وَأُبَطِّلُ قَوْلَ أَغَانِيكِ، وَصَوْتُ أَعْوَادِكِ لَنْ يُسْمَعَ بَعْدُ.
verses.kjv: And I will cause the noise of thy songs to cease; and the sound of thy harps shall be no more heard.
verses.web: I will cause the noise of your songs to cease. The sound of your harps won’t be heard any more.
verses.he: וְהִשְׁבַּתִּ֖י הֲמֹ֣ון שִׁירָ֑יִךְ וְקֹ֣ול כִּנֹּורַ֔יִךְ לֹ֥א יִשָּׁמַ֖ע עֹֽוד׃

verses.ar: وَأُصَيِّرُكِ كَضِحِّ ٱلصَّخْرِ، فَتَكُونِينَ مَبْسَطًا لِلشِّبَاكِ. لَا تُبْنَيْنَ بَعْدُ، لِأَنِّي أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ تَكَلَّمْتُ، يَقُولُ ٱلسَّيِّدُ ٱلرَّبُّ.
verses.kjv: And I will make thee like the top of a rock: thou shalt be [a place] to spread nets upon; thou shalt be built no more: for I the LORD have spoken [it], saith the Lord GOD.
verses.web: I will make you a bare rock. You will be a place for the spreading of nets. You will be built no more; for I Yahweh have spoken it,’ says the Lord Yahweh.
verses.he: וּנְתַתִּ֞יךְ לִצְחִ֣יחַ סֶ֗לַע מִשְׁטַ֤ח חֲרָמִים֙ תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה לֹ֥א תִבָּנֶ֖ה עֹ֑וד כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ דִּבַּ֔רְתִּי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ ס

verses.ar: «هَكَذَا قَالَ ٱلسَّيِّدُ ٱلرَّبُّ لِصُورَ: أَمَا تَتَزَلْزَلُ ٱلْجَزَائِرُ عِنْدَ صَوْتِ سُقُوطِكِ، عِنْدَ صُرَاخِ ٱلْجَرْحَى، عِنْدَ وُقُوعِ ٱلْقَتْلِ فِي وَسْطِكِ؟
verses.kjv: ¶ Thus saith the Lord GOD to Tyrus; Shall not the isles shake at the sound of thy fall, when the wounded cry, when the slaughter is made in the midst of thee?
verses.web: “The Lord Yahweh says to Tyre: ‘Won’t the islands shake at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan, when the slaughter is made within you?
verses.he: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֖ה לְצֹ֑ור הֲלֹ֣א ׀ מִקֹּ֣ול מַפַּלְתֵּ֗ךְ בֶּאֱנֹ֨ק חָלָ֜ל בֵּהָ֤רֵֽג הֶ֙רֶג֙ בְּתֹוכֵ֔ךְ יִרְעֲשׁ֖וּ הָאִיִּֽים׃

verses.ar: فَتَنْزِلُ جَمِيعُ رُؤَسَاءِ ٱلْبَحْرِ عَنْ كَرَاسِيِّهِمْ، وَيَخْلَعُونَ جُبَبَهُمْ، وَيَنْزِعُونَ ثِيَابَهُمُ ٱلْمُطَرَّزَةَ. يَلْبِسُونَ رَعْدَاتٍ، وَيَجْلِسُونَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ، وَيَرْتَعِدُونَ كُلَّ لَحْظَةٍ، وَيَتَحَيَّرُونَ مِنْكِ.
verses.kjv: Then all the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones, and lay away their robes, and put off their broidered garments: they shall clothe themselves with trembling; they shall sit upon the ground, and shall tremble at [every] moment, and be astonished at thee.
verses.web: Then all the princes of the sea will come down from their thrones, and lay aside their robes, and strip off their embroidered garments. They will clothe themselves with trembling. They will sit on the ground, and will tremble every moment, and be astonished at you.
verses.he: וֽ͏ְיָרְד֞וּ מֵעַ֣ל כִּסְאֹותָ֗ם כֹּ֚ל נְשִׂיאֵ֣י הַיָּ֔ם וְהֵסִ֙ירוּ֙ אֶת־מְעִ֣ילֵיהֶ֔ם וְאֶת־בִּגְדֵ֥י רִקְמָתָ֖ם יִפְשֹׁ֑טוּ חֲרָדֹ֤ות ׀ יִלְבָּ֙שׁוּ֙ עַל־הָאָ֣רֶץ יֵשֵׁ֔בוּ וְחָֽרְדוּ֙ לִרְגָעִ֔ים וְשָׁמְמ֖וּ עָלָֽיִךְ׃

verses.ar: وَيَرْفَعُونَ عَلَيْكِ مَرْثَاةً وَيَقُولُونَ لَكِ: كَيْفَ بِدْتِ يَا مَعْمُورَةُ مِنَ ٱلْبِحَارِ، ٱلْمَدِينَةُ ٱلشَّهِيرَةُ ٱلَّتِي كَانَتْ قَوِيَّةً فِي ٱلْبَحْرِ هِيَ وَسُكَّانُهَا ٱلَّذِينَ أَوْقَعُوا رُعْبَهُمْ عَلَى جَمِيعِ جِيرَانِهَا؟
verses.kjv: And they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and say to thee, How art thou destroyed, [that wast] inhabited of seafaring men, the renowned city, which wast strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, which cause their terror [to be] on all that haunt it!
verses.web: They will take up a lamentation over you, and tell you, “How you are destroyed, who were inhabited by seafaring men, the renowned city, who was strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, who caused their terror to be on all who lived there!”
verses.he: וְנָשְׂא֨וּ עָלַ֤יִךְ קִינָה֙ וְאָ֣מְרוּ לָ֔ךְ אֵ֣יךְ אָבַ֔דְתְּ נֹושֶׁ֖בֶת מִיַּמִּ֑ים הָעִ֣יר הַהֻלָּ֗לָה אֲשֶׁר֩ הָיְתָ֨ה חֲזָקָ֤ה בַיָּם֙ הִ֣יא וְיֹשְׁבֶ֔יהָ אֲשֶׁר־נָתְנ֥וּ חִתִּיתָ֖ם לְכָל־יֹושְׁבֶֽיהָ׃

verses.ar: اَلْآنَ تَرْتَعِدُ ٱلْجَزَائِرُ يَوْمَ سُقُوطِكِ وَتَضْطَرِبُ ٱلْجَزَائِرُ ٱلَّتِي فِي ٱلْبَحْرِ لِزَوَالِكِ.
verses.kjv: Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall; yea, the isles that [are] in the sea shall be troubled at thy departure.
verses.web: Now the islands will tremble in the day of your fall. Yes, the islands that are in the sea will be dismayed at your departure.’
verses.he: עַתָּה֙ יֶחְרְד֣וּ הָֽאִיִּ֔ן יֹ֖ום מַפַּלְתֵּ֑ךְ וְנִבְהֲל֛וּ הָאִיִּ֥ים אֲשֶׁר־בַּיָּ֖ם מִצֵּאתֵֽךְ׃ ס

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ هَكَذَا قَالَ ٱلسَّيِّدُ ٱلرَّبُّ: حِينَ أُصَيِّرُكِ مَدِينَةً خَرِبَةً كَٱلْمُدُنِ غَيْرِ ٱلْمَسْكُونَةِ، حِينَ أُصْعِدُ عَلَيْكِ ٱلْغَمْرَ فَتَغْشَاكِ ٱلْمِيَاهُ ٱلْكَثِيرَةُ،
verses.kjv: For thus saith the Lord GOD; When I shall make thee a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited; when I shall bring up the deep upon thee, and great waters shall cover thee;
verses.web: “For the Lord Yahweh says: ‘When I make you a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited, when I bring up the deep on you, and the great waters cover you,
verses.he: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה בְּתִתִּ֤י אֹתָךְ֙ עִ֣יר נֶחֱרֶ֔בֶת כֶּעָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־נֹושָׁ֑בוּ בְּהַעֲלֹ֤ות עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ אֶת־תְּהֹ֔ום וְכִסּ֖וּךְ הַמַּ֥יִם הָרַבִּֽים׃

verses.ar: أُهْبِطُكِ مَعَ ٱلْهَابِطِينَ فِي ٱلْجُبِّ، إِلَى شَعْبِ ٱلْقِدَمِ، وَأُجْلِسُكِ فِي أَسَافِلِ ٱلْأَرْضِ فِي ٱلْخِرَبِ ٱلْأَبَدِيَّةِ مَعَ ٱلْهَابِطِينَ فِي ٱلْجُبِّ، لِتَكُونِي غَيْرَ مَسْكُونَةٍ، وَأَجْعَلُ فَخْرًا فِي أَرْضِ ٱلْأَحْيَاءِ.
verses.kjv: When I shall bring thee down with them that descend into the pit, with the people of old time, and shall set thee in the low parts of the earth, in places desolate of old, with them that go down to the pit, that thou be not inhabited; and I shall set glory in the land of the living;
verses.web: then I will bring you down with those who descend into the pit, to the people of old time, and will make you dwell in the lower parts of the earth, in the places that are desolate of old, with those who go down to the pit, that you be not inhabited; and I will set glory in the land of the living.
verses.he: וְהֹורַדְתִּיךְ֩ אֶת־יֹ֨ורְדֵי בֹ֜ור אֶל־עַ֣ם עֹולָ֗ם וְ֠הֹושַׁבְתִּיךְ בְּאֶ֨רֶץ תַּחְתִּיֹּ֜ות כָּחֳרָבֹ֤ות מֵֽעֹולָם֙ אֶת־יֹ֣ורְדֵי בֹ֔ור לְמַ֖עַן לֹ֣א תֵשֵׁ֑בִי וְנָתַתִּ֥י צְבִ֖י בְּאֶ֥רֶץ חַיִּֽים׃

verses.ar: أُصَيِّرُكِ أَهْوَالًا، وَلَا تَكُونِينَ، وَتُطْلَبِينَ فَلَا تُوجَدِينَ بَعْدُ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ، يَقُولُ ٱلسَّيِّدُ ٱلرَّبُّ».
verses.kjv: I will make thee a terror, and thou [shalt be] no [more:] though thou be sought for, yet shalt thou never be found again, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.web: I will make you a terror, and you will no more have any being. Though you are sought for, yet you will never be found again,’ says the Lord Yahweh.”
verses.he: בַּלָּהֹ֥ות אֶתְּנֵ֖ךְ וְאֵינֵ֑ךְ וּֽתְבֻקְשִׁ֗י וְלֹֽא־תִמָּצְאִ֥י עֹוד֙ לְעֹולָ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהֹוִֽה׃ ס
